name: local-scan-companion
description: Guided Docker Compose setup for local MCP ZAP Server in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Set up MCP ZAP Server and ZAP locally in Codex using the project's Docker Compose setup. Requires Docker and Docker Compose already installed and running, plus local command execution. Use the setup skill to obtain the project, start its versioned release containers, and configure a separate authenticated MCP connection after startup succeeds. Installing this skills-only plugin does not install Docker, start the scanner, or expose MCP tools. Setup finishes with a connection check; scans require your target and intended workflow. Web-only chats cannot reach your machine's loopback server. Public-directory approval is pending. This independent project is not affiliated with or endorsed by ZAP or OpenAI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up the local scanner in Codex.
